run_test_400m: run the TestMetaCLIPConfig test_400m method to validate b32_400m, b16_400m, and l14_400m config lookups
run_test_2_5B: run the TestMetaCLIPConfig test_2_5B method to validate b32_fullcc, b16_fullcc, l14_fullcc, and h14_fullcc config lookups
run_unittest: run python -m unittest tests.config_test to execute all MetaCLIP config validation tests
test_search_config: test the search_config function by looking up a config name and verifying its name and output_dir attributes
review_TestMetaCLIPConfig: review the TestMetaCLIPConfig class and its test_400m and test_2_5B methods for config validation logic
